_comment: Camera.Source: USB index ("0"), an rtsp:// URL, or a path to a video file.
Leave it empty to run the synthetic demo with no hardware attached.
Leave it empty for the deterministic SampleDetector, so the demo runs
with no model on disk. See README for the export command.
Detector.ClassId is a COCO index: 15 = cat (development), 14 = bird (coop).
Retargeting the system is this number plus ClassName, nothing in the code.
Detector.ExecutionProvider: "directml" runs inference on the GPU, "cpu"
forces the CPU. DirectML falls back to the CPU on its own if no DX12 GPU
is present; the startup banner names whichever one actually opened.
Detector.GpuDeviceId picks the GPU by adapter index. On a laptop with
switchable graphics index 0 is often the integrated chip - here that was
193 ms per frame against 28 ms on the discrete card. The banner lists the
GPUs it can see; if inference is slow, try the other index.
